summary: TDD identified and corrected a registration transaction defect in the public controller. Before the change, known transport and simulated unknown failures erased valid non-secret form identity, and a failed re-registration replaced the alias of an already-approved demo account. The bounded fix preserves the live registration draft on failed outcomes only when the registration route is still relevant, and commits synthetic email/identity aliases only after provider success. Focused, full controller, and relevant non-style HH tests passed. No canonical build or Git landing was performed.

candidate.worktree: exactly the two authorized paths are modified; no commit

implementation.serviceSeam: Registration.registerTeacher only: immediately before syncRuntime, capture the current non-secret registration identity when the current route is register. Restore it only on failure/unknown outcome and only if the route remains register at the same captured epoch. Successful results keep the provider-confirmed registration projection.
implementation.aliasTransaction: Move aliasToFixtureEmail and identityByFixtureEmail writes to a synchronous pre-sync callback that runs only for result.ok. A failed or unknown re-registration leaves an existing approved alias untouched. No automatic retry was added.
nonGoals: No change to route, owner, geography, captured-profile, or success policy
implementation.reviewLimit: H2 nav-away/back behavior is an independent review target and is not claimed verified by H1's tests.

observations.preFixRed: Known failure and unknown outcome lost rendered identity; approved-alias test could no longer log in after failed re-registration.
observations.knownFailureAfterFix: Current draft (including name/email/phone updated while provider promise was pending) and school remain rendered; provider has no registration; public:retry returns nothing_to_retry without another write; explicit resubmission with fresh ephemeral credentials succeeds.
observations.unknownOutcomeAfterFix: Draft and school remain; no provider registration is present in the fixture; public retry performs no second write.
observations.approvedAliasAfterFix: Registration attempt 2 returns injected transport_failure; login still uses the original alias index 1 and succeeds after approval.
observations.credentials: All new password/confirmation values use randomUUID() at test execution and are checked absent from controller state, runtime inspection, Parts, and memory storage.

initialSelectorAttempt.note: Initial regex selected only the two test names beginning with registration; it omitted the failed re-registration test. This is preserved as non-definitive selector-attempt testimony, not the complete red gate.

limits: Controller/render-tree tests only; no mounted-browser or visual QA.
No canonical Bazel build in E1403; root reserved that for the next native build packet.
No commit, push, publication, or deployment.
H2 independent nav-away/back review remains pending; the H1 guard is limited to a current registration route at pre-sync and does not claim epoch-change coverage.
